hook: Ilya Sutskever was born in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, and moved with his family first to Israel and then to Canada, where he studied computer science at the University of Toronto under Geoffrey Hinton. In 2012 he co-authored the AlexNet paper with Alex Krizhevsky and Hinton, a deep convolutional network that sharply cut ImageNet classification error rates and helped launch the modern deep learning era. He followed this in 2014 with Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks, showing that a general encoder-decoder architecture could handle tasks like machine translation. In December 2015 he co-founded OpenAI, serving first as Research Director and later as Chief Scientist while the lab built its GPT model series. He left OpenAI in 2024 and co-founded Safe Superintelligence Inc with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy, a company dedicated to a single goal, building safe superintelligence, and became its CEO in mid-2025 after Gross departed.

timeline.event: Born in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, then part of the Soviet Union
timeline.impact: His family later moved to Israel and then Canada, where he pursued computer science.

timeline.event: Publishes ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (AlexNet) with Alex Krizhevsky and Geoffrey Hinton
timeline.impact: The network's sharp cut in ImageNet error rates is widely credited with helping start the modern deep learning wave.

timeline.event: Completes graduate studies in computer science at the University of Toronto under Geoffrey Hinton
timeline.impact: Built the research foundation he carried into industry roles at Google and later OpenAI.

timeline.event: Publishes Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks with Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le
timeline.impact: Established a general encoder-decoder framework later used across translation and language systems.

timeline.event: Co-founds OpenAI in December as Research Director
timeline.impact: Helped launch what became one of the most prominent AI research labs.

timeline.event: Leaves OpenAI and co-founds Safe Superintelligence Inc with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy
timeline.impact: Started a lab built around a single goal, developing safe superintelligence, rather than shipping consumer products.

timeline.event: Becomes CEO of Safe Superintelligence Inc after co-founder Daniel Gross departs
timeline.impact: Took on day-to-day leadership of the company alongside his research role.

quick_facts: Co-authored the 2012 AlexNet paper that helped launch the modern deep learning boom in computer vision
Co-authored the 2014 Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks paper, an early architecture behind neural machine translation
Co-founded OpenAI in December 2015 and later served as its Chief Scientist
Left OpenAI in 2024 to co-found Safe Superintelligence Inc, a company focused solely on building safe superintelligence
Became CEO of Safe Superintelligence Inc in mid-2025 after co-founder Daniel Gross departed
